summary: Code review PASS with two Fix-Forward improvements applied. Test suite is well-structured: isolated fixtures via makeFixture(), local bare-repo via buildOrigin(), clear precondition assertions, and comprehensive coverage of all three public API methods (createProject, deleteProject, renameProject). Two non-behavioral dead-code items were cleaned up directly.

comments.note: Removed dead `wsOrchestrator` variable in 'deleteProject removes all workspace subfolders (cascading)' test. A WorkspaceOrchestrator instance was being constructed with `{} as any` mocks and immediately discarded — never referenced in any assertion. Removing it eliminates misleading noise without changing test behavior.

Removed unused `repoManager` from destructuring in 'deleteProject succeeds when project folder does not exist on disk' test. The variable was destructured from makeFixture() but never referenced in the test body. Removed to reduce clutter.

Overall test quality is high: each test targets exactly one behavior, uses makeTempDir() for full isolation, and includes precondition assertions that make failures self-diagnosing. The makeFixture() factory cleanly encapsulates the multi-layer dependency graph without repetition.
